classification: candidate formalization design; no source admission or world-truth proof
denominator_rule: Generate requirements independently from submitted result lists; omitted, weakened or substituted required statements fail aggregation.

obligation_types.required_evidence: Actual attributable correspondence review; tests cannot establish prose equivalence.
obligation_types.statement: Exact source clauses preserve their meaning in the interpretation.
Signatures, binding, arity and sort rules hold.

obligation_types.required_evidence: Explicit version-bound graph and joint SCC composition.
obligation_types.statement: All required exact external and transitive meanings are included.

obligation_types.required_evidence: Independently checked model or an appropriate complete satisfiability route; bounded absence does not refute general consistency.
obligation_types.statement: There exists M satisfying the entire included theory T.

obligation_types.required_evidence: One checked combined model, not separate witnesses under incompatible assignments.
obligation_types.statement: There exists M satisfying T and every declared required population I together.

obligation_types.required_evidence: Checked exact model witness; does not establish distinction in every model.
obligation_types.statement: There exists M satisfying T and I with the selected difference/inference counterexample.

obligation_types.required_evidence: Required solver/proof strength with separate consistency and inhabitation guards; bounded exhaustion only at its declared bound.
obligation_types.statement: Every admissible M satisfying the selected premises satisfies the target.

obligation_types.required_evidence: Base and step/reachability evidence in a separately defined transition semantics.
obligation_types.statement: Selected initial states satisfy the invariant and allowed transitions preserve it.

obligation_types.required_evidence: Exact expansion/restriction or consequence-preservation claim; unchanged fixtures are insufficient.
obligation_types.statement: Selected extension preserves old-vocabulary consequences/model behavior at the claimed strength.

obligation_types.required_evidence: Digest/reference checks and required-set comparison; not a semantic proof.
obligation_types.statement: All exact source, statement, profile and toolchain bindings remain current and applicable.

readiness_rule: All required current applicable evidence and necessary source reviews must meet the selected criteria; an honest administrative disposition is not proof.
strength_policy: Strength is proposition-dependent, not one universal linear ranking. Model evidence establishes a witness; theorem evidence establishes its exact universally/conditionally quantified statement under audited assumptions.
